name: Template picker lists all templates and search filters them
description: The Template studio picker shows the full template gallery (around 57 cards) and the search box filters by name/tag/category.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root URL / and click the 'Template studio — HTML decks' mode switch tab.
Locate the 'Pick a template' gallery and wait for the template cards to render (they load lazily; scroll the gallery if needed).
Verify a large grid of template cards is shown (50 or more cards).
Type 'biennale' into the template search box (placeholder mentions 'Search name, tagline, category, best-for, tags…').
Verify the gallery filters down to the matching card(s) — expect 1 card whose name or tags contain 'Biennale'.
Clear the search box, then type 'reveal'.
Verify at least one matching template card remains visible for the reveal.js engine templates.
Clear the search box and click on any template card to select it.
Verify the clicked card shows a selected state (highlight border or checkmark), and the brief area becomes the focus with a generate button enabled once a brief is typed.
